candidates: In `VersionService.getCliIntegrationFromAncestry` (code/lib/create-storybook/src/services/VersionService.ts), each CLI tool detection branch must use precise pattern matching — such as a regex anchored to known invocation forms (e.g. `create <tool>@<version>`, `<tool> new|init|create`) with word boundaries — rather than a raw `.includes('<tool>')` substring check on `ancestor.command`. A plain substring check can misclassify unrelated commands that happen to contain the tool name, producing false telemetry attribution; flag any new branch that relies solely on `.includes()` and require a regex or tokenized check instead.
